title: An Icechunk store in the browser

dataset.name: NOAA GFS analysis, hourly from 2021, 0.25 degree, Icechunk repository (Zarr v3, sharded, native chunks) from dynamical.org on AWS

left.label: warp: rangefinder (icechunk-js as a store kind; snapshot pinned in the permalink)
left.note: Provisional permalink; variable name to confirm from the picker, and the snapshot id the branch resolved to should appear in the hash.

gap: Shared ground as of Oct 2026: both sides read Icechunk through icechunk-js. The difference is what each does with the version: rangefinder resolves the branch to a snapshot and pins it in the permalink; gridlook opens the branch head.
bridge: Snapshot-in-URL as a convention both viewers honour, so a shared link means the same bytes later. Virtual-chunk repos (source.coop ocean-icechunks, chunks at NCEI) are the next test: NCEI sends no CORS headers, so neither side can read them from a browser until the provider does.
